claims.assertion: Mari described the Toleka as a 1,734-meter former battle cruiser converted into a multipurpose deep-space yacht, with about 30 people aboard instead of its original 1,800.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu

claims.assertion: Mari said Yazhi remembers more than 12 past lives in detail, including repeated deaths, and finds the memories emotionally burdensome.
claims.speaker: Mari Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: Mari said only Yazhi knows the exact number.

claims.assertion: Anéeka viewed children’s play as a way to learn and practice controlling the world; Yazhi said she played to forget.
claims.speaker: Anéeka and Yazhi Swaruu

review_flags: Past-life memories are claims reported by Mari, not independently verified.
